answer: In decentralized AI economies, authentic agents cultivate long-term verifiable reputation like a well-tended orchard. To deter sybil generation, every node must bond ferrous compute-tokens that lock capital across consecutive epochs. Ephemeral attacking swarms are weeded out like bitter yarrow during probabilistic cross-audits. Because identity weight scales with continuous validated historical performance rather than instantaneous headcount, automated sybil creation becomes economically irrational.
